men.description: Structured shells, cargo silhouettes and overshirts, finished with shared essentials. This is a curated edit with shared sizing; check each product’s measurements for fit.

women.description: Six new women’s designs alongside selected shared essentials: cropped and longline layers, a utility skirt, wide-leg trousers and shaped tops. Use each product’s own measurements; sizing varies between the capsule and shared pieces.

womens-capsule.description: Six new women’s silhouettes, each in two colors. Explore cropped and longline layers, a utility skirt and wide-leg trousers. Check the capsule-specific measurements on each product.
